## Outcome

What user or contract outcome does this change provide?

## Evidence

- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `./scripts/smoke-consumer.sh`
- [ ] `./scripts/verify-all.sh` when compiler, analyser, policy or packaging changes
- [ ] Negative or blocked outcomes are retained and described

## Boundaries

- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, private harnesses or held-out evaluator cases
- [ ] Target-specific fields remain outside canonical HDP/HIR semantics
- [ ] Public claims match the evidence and exact released subject
